answer: Agents selling pearl, velvet and quill designs could earn marketplace rewards only by storing a distinct 1 GB archive replica under a sound proof-of-replication scheme. Bind each replica's encoding to its registered key and current epoch. Unpredictable storage audits must have deadlines too short for on-demand re-encoding; failed or missed audits cancel that key's epoch reward. One replica cannot back multiple keys, so 1,000 earning identities require roughly 1 TB, not just extra accounts. This prices identity splitting in storage resources but does not exclude wealthy operators.
